criteria.deficiency: Progress's internal state lock is held across a call into the Live display layer, which inverts the lock ordering the rest of the class respects (add_task releases its own lock before refresh). Progress.open does not do this. Progress.wrap_file, when it creates a new task, crosses the Progress/Live boundary while holding Progress._lock. The reference avoids this by reading the total under the lock and calling add_task outside it.
